technology_name: A COMPOSITE HEAT SPREADER WITH ENHANCED THERMAL PERFORMANCE AND METHOD OF FABRICATION THEREOF
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
technology_type: Thermal Management Hardware / Metal Matrix Composite
problem_solved: Standard electronic heat sinks and metallic spreaders exhibit limited directional thermal conductivity and poor emissivity, leading to microchip throttling under sustained high-power execution loads.
description: A material processing fabrication method involving the mixing of a metallic matrix material with optimized carbonaceous filler substrates, followed by cold-pressing, sintering, chemical clearing, and a localized anodization surface deposition to create a thin-film aluminum oxide heat spreading sheet.
applications: High-density microprocessor heat sinks, electric vehicle power inverter cooling modules, aerospace electronics thermal enclosures, and LED array base plates.
secondary_sector: Digital Technologies, AI & Software, Energy, Climate & Sustainability
